$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKM (AIP France, chart dated 2017-09-14): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Saint-Galmier

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .

AD reserved for ACFT and gliders whose pilots have been recognized fit to use the AD by an instructor (or hold a flight instructor qualification) AD usable by HEL and ULM AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
TKOF and LDG prohibited for motorized ACFT except for emergency landing from 1130 to 1315 and from 1900 to 0800 (SUM: - 1 HR).
Flights of aeroplanes and ULM are prohibited during parachuting.

AD located within CTR SAINT-ETIENNE. a) IFR approach path to Saint-Etienne Loire AD via EB, above R 224. b) Special instruction inside restricted area: 1) inside R 224 (MAX 500 ft ASFC) possible flight on A/A 123.5 and without transponder.

2) to leave R 224, mandatory clearance to enter CTR: signal flight purpose before take off on 119.250, otherwise contact immediately ST ETIENNE TWR after taking off.; stay within R 224 as far as possible until obtaining the clearance to enter CTR.
Activity reserved for authorized pilots and according to the current agreement protocol.
The effective activity is known by SAINT-ETIENNE TWR, CLERMONT INFO, LYON INFO, and MARSEILLE ACC.
Other SKED announced by NOTAM AEM (NR 9905): 500 ft ASFC, during R 224 activation.

Aérodrome réservé aux avions et planeurs dont les pilotes ont été reconnus aptes à utiliser l'aérodrome par un instructeur (ou détiennent une qualification d'instructeur). Aérodrome utilisable par les HEL et ULM. AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Décollages et atterrissages interdits à tout aéronef motorisé, sauf atterrissage d'urgence de 1130 à 1315 et de 1900 à 0800.
Les vols avions et ULM, sont interdits lors des parachutages.

AD situé à l'intérieur de la CTR SAINT-ETIENNE. a) Trajectoire d'approche IFR de Saint-Etienne Loire axée sur EB, au-dessus de la R 224. b) Consigne particulière en zone réglementée : 1) à l'intérieur de la R 224 (MAX 500 ft ASFC), vol possible en A/A sur 123.5 et sans transpondeur.

2) pour sortir de la R 224, clairance obligatoire pour entrer dans la CTR : signaler l'intention de vol avant le décollage sur 119.250, sinon contacter ST-ETIENNE TWR immédiatement après décollage. se maintenir dans la R 224 jusqu'à l'obtention de la clairance pour pénétrer dans la CTR.
Autres HOR annoncés par NOTAM AEM (N° 9905) : 500 ft ASFC, HOR activation R 224.
